title: Don't Ping
hook: My sonar is the only way to see down here. Every time I use it, something hears me

messages.text: Twelve hundred meters down, your screen only shows what your sonar touches. Every ping lights up the cave... and tells everything in it exactly where you are.
messages.label: DEPTH 1,240 M

messages.text: Jay needed one last part to get home. It was right there, at the mouth of a tunnel.
He pinged. The cave lit up... and so did something enormous. Right beside the hull.
Don't move. Don't move. Don't move.
Engines off. No pings. He drifted through the dark, completely blind, while something circled the sub. Then... a scrape. Along the hull.
He grabbed the part with the claw. Three of three. But the claw was loud... and the lurkers heard it.
messages.label: PARTS 3/3

messages.text: Full throttle. Every engine roar was a dinner bell. The hatch was fifty meters up, and the stalker was right behind him.
He made it. But inside the hatch, the Halcyon's black box was still playing...
If anyone hears this... do not go deeper.
This is Deep Signal. Free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game, so play it on a computer. And wear headphones.
